title: About Me
subTitle: I am a Software Developer with a strong foundation in both backend and front-end development. I specialize in building scalable, user-focused applications that address real-world problems. My passion lies in creating strong systems, and I thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

sections.title: Softskills that pay the bills
sections.copy: In addition to my design and technical expertise—I also have strong leadership, time management, and multitasking skills—honed through my experience as a business owner / managing partner. Outside of work, I enjoy staying active through sports such as basketball and video games. I am confident in my ability to bring passion and value to any project.

sections.title: Research and planning
sections.copy: One of my favorite aspects of creating is planning the architecture of a project. From Design Systems to Brand Strategy—I enjoy working with the many touch points of user experience.
